title: Dynamic fluctuations of emotional states in adolescents with delayed sleep phase-A longitudinal network modeling approach
limitations: - DSP was based on only one diagnostic criterion; - DSP was assessed only once; - Small sample size; - Potential selection bias due to EMA burden
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are available. The authors mention that the study was part of a larger cohort (SleepHelsinki!) but do not specify availability of EMA data or code for this specific analysis. The paper was not found to be pre-registered.
